purpose: Explain MySQL's SQL-processing engine, Handler API, pluggable storage engines and disk files in distinct boundaries. Replace logos/gears with a new text-first layout. Memory is an in-memory engine, so do not invent a direct disk path.
requiredChecks: Client API tier lists Java, C++, .NET, PHP, Python, Go and Ruby; it lies outside MySQL server.
MySQL engine contains connection handler, SQL parser/preprocessor, optimizer, execution engine, and a separate cache/buffer supporting box.
SQL pipeline arrows run client→connection→parser/preprocessor→optimizer→execution, and execution accesses Handler API.
Storage engines InnoDB, MyISAM, Memory are peers separate from SQL-processing; each connects bidirectionally with Handler API.
Operating system/disk tier includes data files and log files outside server; InnoDB and MyISAM reach disk; Memory has no direct disk connector.
All required Korean labels and MySQL-server boundaries are readable and accurate; no copied logos or gears.
alt: MySQL 엔진의 SQL 처리 흐름, 핸들러 API, 스토리지 엔진과 디스크 파일의 역할 분리
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational infographic-diagram. Create a NEW original architecture diagram for a Korean technical blog about MySQL. Explain the separation between the MySQL SQL-processing engine, the storage engines, their Handler API, and disk files. Do not reproduce any textbook composition or artwork. White background, flat navy outlines, blue/teal boxes, crisp readable Korean sans-serif lettering, generous margins and whitespace. No gradients, shadows, logos, mascots, decorative gears or document illustrations.
Title exactly "MySQL 엔진 아키텍처".
Use a wide landscape diagram with four clear horizontal tiers, all contained in the canvas.
Top narrow tier labeled "클라이언트 API" with text-only labels "Java · C++ · .NET · PHP · Python · Go · Ruby".
Second tier inside one boundary labeled "MySQL 엔진". Include left-to-right SQL-processing boxes "커넥션 핸들러" → "SQL 파서·전처리기" → "옵티마이저" → "실행 엔진". Above or below that row put a separate supporting box "캐시·버퍼". Indicate SQL-processing requests flow from client API to connection handler, along the four boxes, and from the execution engine down toward the Handler API. Do not depict cache/buffer as a mandatory pipeline step and do not label it query cache.
Third tier is separated from MySQL 엔진: a horizontal band "핸들러 API" immediately above a boundary labeled "스토리지 엔진". Inside are THREE peer storage engine boxes "InnoDB", "MyISAM", "Memory". Each receives its own bidirectional connector from the Handler API, representing read/write requests and results. Storage engine boundary must not include the SQL parser or optimizer.
Bottom tier is a separate boundary labeled "운영체제 · 디스크" containing only two boxes "데이터 파일" and "로그 파일". Draw bidirectional connectors from InnoDB and MyISAM down to this disk boundary. Do NOT draw a direct connector from Memory to disk because it is an in-memory engine.
Footer exactly "SQL 분석·최적화와 데이터 읽기·쓰기를 분리".
Show a clearly labeled outer boundary encompassing MySQL 엔진, 핸들러 API and 스토리지 엔진, labeled "MySQL 서버". Client API and 운영체제 · 디스크 are outside that server boundary.
All Korean and English labels must be spelled exactly. Ensure arrowheads do not overlap text, every boundary is unambiguous, and all five processing/supporting boxes and three storage engines are present. Do not add any other technologies or text.
